method.title: How this value was estimated:
method.text: the simulation adds salary balance, notice when indemnified, proportional 13th salary, vacation plus one-third, manual credits and applicable deductions.
method.sourceNote: CLT, FGTS, notice and 2026 INSS/IRRF rules were referenced on 2026-05-31. Educational result only; official TRCT, eSocial, FGTS Digital and professional review prevail.

howToCalculate.title: How to calculate Brazilian CLT severance
howToCalculate.p1: A CLT severance estimate starts with base remuneration, formed by monthly salary and habitual variable averages entered by the user.
howToCalculate.p2: The calculator estimates salary balance, notice, 13th salary, vacation plus one-third, FGTS, fine and deductions, separating each item for review.

withoutCause.title: What enters dismissal without cause
withoutCause.intro: In dismissal without cause, the estimate includes the main items normally reviewed in a Brazilian TRCT.
withoutCause.b1: Salary balance for the exit month.
withoutCause.b2: Worked or indemnified notice, with proportional days by service time.
withoutCause.b3: Proportional 13th salary and overdue or proportional vacation plus one-third.
withoutCause.b4: 40% FGTS fine and displayed eligible FGTS withdrawal.

resignation.title: Resignation
resignation.body: Resignation keeps salary balance, 13th salary and vacation, but this simulator does not show an FGTS fine or immediate withdrawal. Notice may be worked, waived or deducted.

dismissal.title: Dismissal without cause
dismissal.body: Dismissal without cause may include indemnified notice, FGTS fine and withdrawal of the eligible balance, besides proportional items.

notice.title: Worked, indemnified and deducted notice
notice.p1: Proportional notice starts at 30 days and adds 3 days per full year of service, capped at 90 days.
notice.p2: When notice is indemnified, projection may affect 13th salary and vacation avos. On resignation, this calculator deducts 30 days only when selected.

vacationThirteenthFgts.title: How vacation, 13th salary and FGTS are estimated
vacationThirteenthFgts.p1: The 13th salary counts months in the termination year with at least 15 contract days. Proportional vacation counts the current acquisition period and is capped at 11/12.
vacationThirteenthFgts.p2: Termination FGTS is estimated at 8% over selected remuneratory items. If no FGTS balance is entered, the historical base is approximated from current remuneration.

limits.title: Calculator limits and when to seek help
limits.p1: This simulation does not replace TRCT, eSocial, FGTS Digital, accountant, union or lawyer review. Collective agreements, stability, leaves, absences, variable averages and prior payments can change results.
limits.p2: Domestic workers, apprentices, temporary contracts, probation contracts, public servants and complex judicial cases are outside this first scope.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator provides an educational estimate, not legal, tax or payroll advice. Official TRCT, eSocial, FGTS Digital and professional review prevail.

q1.question: Does the calculator show the exact net amount?
q1.answer: No. It estimates items and deductions from the typed inputs. The official amount depends on payroll, TRCT, eSocial, FGTS Digital, collective agreement and professional review.

q2.question: How do I calculate dismissal without cause?
q2.answer: It usually includes salary balance, notice, proportional 13th salary, vacation plus one-third, 40% FGTS fine and eligible FGTS withdrawal. The calculator separates each item.

q3.question: Does resignation receive an FGTS fine?
q3.answer: In this simulator, resignation does not generate an FGTS termination fine or immediate withdrawal. Salary balance, 13th salary and vacation may still exist.

q4.question: How much FGTS applies to mutual agreement?
q4.answer: Mutual agreement estimates a 20% fine over the FGTS base and displays withdrawal of up to 80% of the eligible balance.

q5.question: Does proportional notice count in the calculation?
q5.answer: When indemnified, proportional notice enters as a credit and may project 13th salary and vacation avos. When worked, the termination date should already reflect the last worked day.

q6.question: Do overdue vacations enter even with cause?
q6.answer: Yes, the calculator keeps overdue vacation plus one-third when you enter overdue periods, but removes proportional vacation and proportional 13th salary in dismissal with cause.

q7.question: What changes with variable pay, overtime or commissions?
q7.answer: Enter the habitual monthly average in the variable remuneration field. It increases the base used for salary, notice, vacation, 13th salary and related estimates.
